description: Defines the SavedSearch class for managing saved search configurations in SuiteCRM, including form rendering, retrieval, saving, deletion, and serialization/deserialization of search data.

classes.name: SavedSearch
classes.description: Represents saved search configurations, providing methods for form display, retrieval, saving, deletion, and serialization of search parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a SavedSearch object with optional columns, order, and sort direction.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Generates the HTML form for managing saved searches, including search options and column chooser.

methods.name: getTemplateGroupChooser
methods.description: Creates and configures a TemplateGroupChooser object for selecting display columns.

methods.name: getSelect
methods.description: Returns HTML for a dropdown of saved searches for a given module.

methods.name: returnSavedSearch
methods.description: Redirects to the index page with parameters loaded from a saved search.

methods.name: returnSavedSearchContents
methods.description: Retrieves and unserializes the contents of a saved search by ID.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Marks a saved search as deleted and redirects.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the current search parameters as a saved search and optionally redirects.

methods.name: handleRedirect
methods.description: Performs a redirect to the index page with search parameters.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Populates additional list fields like search_module and assigned_user_name.

methods.name: retrieveSavedSearch
methods.description: Loads a saved search from the database and unserializes its contents.

methods.name: populateRequest
methods.description: Populates $_REQUEST and $_GET with search parameters from the saved search contents.
